The orchestrator will see your output beside the other two agents' and will assemble the final answer.
Do your part completely and state plainly anything you could not settle, so the orchestrator can.

YOUR SUBTASK (2 of 3): Physics check detail and what was not checked
Using the shared validate_generation output, write a concise prose section focused on the physics_check and the criteria/gates that were not covered. Include: 1 of 3 hard criteria (glide/glide_range_total_m, the >=10 m glide from 1 m launch) has NO MODEL and was NOT checked, so the physics gate does not cover it; the standing check organ_volume_fits_body@adult failed, reported beside the gate and not folded into it: only 84.7 % of the requested flight-muscle volume fits inside the skin, the remaining 15.3 % has nowhere to go, so any power claim charging the full muscle mass is unphysical. Make clear the physics status is cannot-assess (not pass), yet the standing check failure is a real finding the collaborator needs to see. Also explain that genotype similarity cannot-assess is because the design has only morphological parameter deltas and no gene-level edit, so there is no allele to score, and that this is not a pass. Do not mention the composite score. Assert nothing not in the output.

parsed.report:
Physics check: cannot-assess. This is not a pass. The tool's gate reads "CANNOT FULLY ASSESS: INCOMPLETE". Of the 3 hard criteria parsed from your phenotype text, 1 has NO MODEL and was NOT checked. That is the glide criterion (glide / glide_range_total_m, at least 10 m from a 1 m launch). The physics gate does not cover it, so nothing here says whether ff-zf-chimera can glide 10 m. The other two hard criteria are the temperature survival checks at 18 C and 28 C as an adult. The output does not report a physics result for them in the fields you gave me, so I'm not claiming anything about them.

The standing physical check organ_volume_fits_body@adult failed. It is reported beside the gate and is not folded into it. Only 84.7 % of the requested flight-muscle volume fits inside the skin (analytic capacity transfer, validate/sanity.mjs). The remaining 15.3 % has nowhere to go. Any power claim that charges the full muscle mass is therefore unphysical. This is a real finding, even though the physics status itself is cannot-assess rather than fail.

Genotype similarity: cannot-assess. This is not a pass. The generated design has no gene-level edit (n_edits is 0). The difference from zebrafish-adult is a set of morphological parameter deltas, and a parameter delta has no allele to score. No sequence was assessed: loci_covered is 0 and no part of the genome was compared.

For context, the other results are as follows. Phenotype similarity passed: the design is inside the calibrated shape distribution (body p 0.2649). That is shape similarity, not relatedness, and it is silent on every feature the comparison does not read. The Lean check and the functional-resolution ledger are both cannot-assess.

The word "validated" is withheld. Three biological scales (cell, tissue, organ_system) could not be assessed.

no sequence was compared at any locus
